changes.detail: 4 programs re-verified unchanged (property tax exemption incl. Amendment G individual-unemployability expansion, CONG Tuition Waiver, state hiring preference 5/10 points, five Veterans Community Living Centers) via official search results from vets.colorado.gov, dmva.colorado.gov, careers.colorado.gov, cdhs.colorado.gov.

changes.program: Free Lifetime Fishing and Small Game Combination License (VA Combo License)
changes.detail: CPW moved the military hunters page from /hunting/hunters-military to /activities/hunting/hunters-military; eligibility (50%+ service-connected disability or Purple Heart, free lifetime resident small game/fishing combo) unchanged per cpw.state.co.us search result.

4 programs re-verified unchanged: P&T property tax exemption (PA 24-46, effective Oct 1 2024; dwelling or one motor vehicle), Veterans Tuition Waiver (100% General Fund tuition at UConn/CSCU), state exam preference (10 points for wartime veterans eligible for VA compensation, 5 otherwise, open-competitive passing scores only), DEEP free fishing license for veterans with a disability - via official portal.ct.gov search results.

Renamed to the facility's current official name and corrected the blurb: the DVA skilled nursing page describes the Sgt. John L. Levitow Healthcare Center as a 125-bed Medicare/Medicaid-certified skilled nursing facility, plus a separate Residential Facility offering temporary supportive living aimed at returning veterans to independent living. Prior blurb's 'assisted living' and 'hospice' claims are not on the current official page, so they were removed. Source now portal.ct.gov/dva/skilled-nursing-facility.

5 programs re-verified unchanged via official search results: Disabled Veterans School Property Tax Credit (100% P&T or IU, 3-year domicile; all 16 non-vocational districts participate) at finance.delaware.gov; children-of-deceased-veterans education benefit at vets.delaware.gov; merit hiring preference 5/10 points at statejobs.delaware.gov; Delaware Veterans Home in Milford (skilled nursing plus dementia unit); DNREC hunting/trapping/fishing license exemption for 60%+ service-connected veterans (one-time application at documents.dnrec.delaware.gov).

3 programs re-verified unchanged via official dc.gov search results: Disabled Veterans Homestead Deduction (P&T or 100% IU, District domicile, household income cap tied to Senior/Disabled Tax Relief), DOES veteran priority of service, DMV veteran designation (DD 214/WD AGO/DD 256). The DOES 24-hour job-order hold detail was not re-surfaced in this pass's snippets and is carried forward from the prior verification.

changes.program: Veterans Preference in DC Government Hiring
changes.detail: Source moved from ova.dc.gov/page/employment-0 to the authoritative DCHR Electronic Personnel Manual Chapter 7A (dchr.dc.gov); blurb sharpened to the 5-point / 10-point structure stated there (10 points for disabled veterans, eligible spouses and survivors).

DC DMV release states the no-fee benefit for P&T disabled veterans applies only to annual registration fees, for one set of tags on a non-commercial vehicle; prior blurb overstated it as waiving application and renewal fees. Source dmv.dc.gov/release/veterans-specialty-license-plates.

2 programs re-verified unchanged via official search results: C.W. Bill Young Veteran Tuition Waiver (out-of-state fee waiver created by HB 7015, 2014) and Veterans' Preference in Public Employment (Ch. 295 F.S.; special consideration at each step of selection) at floridavets.org.

Renamed 'Veteran Property Tax Exemptions' and corrected the 10% tier: per Florida DOR (PT-109 and the Taxpayers Exemptions page) it is a $5,000 reduction in assessed value available to veterans disabled 10%+ in wartime or by service-connected misfortune and is not limited to homestead property; the total-and-permanent full homestead exemption is unchanged.

Source moved from the FDVA Benefits Guide PDF to the official State Veterans' Homes page (floridavets.org/locations/state-veterans-nursing-homes/), and the blurb now states the current footprint it lists: eight skilled nursing facilities and one assisted living facility.

changes.program: Hunting and Fishing License Fee Exemptions for Disabled Veterans
changes.detail: Replaced with the program's official FWC name, 'Persons with Disabilities Resident Hunting/Fishing License', citing myfwc.com/license/accessibility/hunt-fish/: a free five-year license for honorably discharged veterans with a 50%+ VA service-connected rating, covering hunting, fresh/saltwater fishing and most permits. The prior blurb's vague 'qualifying disabilities' is now the statutory 50% threshold, and the source moved from the FDVA guide PDF to the FWC page.

states.name: Colorado

programs.name: Property Tax Exemption for Veterans with a Disability and Gold Star Spouses
programs.blurb: Exempts 50% of the first $200,000 of actual value of the primary residence for veterans rated 100% permanent and total (or with individual unemployability status) and for Gold Star spouses.

programs.name: Colorado National Guard Tuition Waiver Program
programs.blurb: Waives up to 100% of in-state tuition for eligible Colorado Air and Army National Guard members pursuing undergraduate or graduate coursework at approved Colorado institutions.

programs.name: Veterans' Preference in State Employment
programs.blurb: Awards five preference points to eligible veterans (ten points for veterans with a service-connected disability) in Colorado state classified hiring.

programs.name: Colorado Veterans Community Living Centers
programs.blurb: Five state-operated long-term care homes providing skilled nursing, therapy, and memory care to honorably discharged veterans, their spouses, and Gold Star parents.

programs.name: Free Lifetime Fishing and Small Game Combination License (VA Combo License)
programs.blurb: Provides a free lifetime fishing and small-game hunting combination license to resident veterans with a service-connected disability of 50% or more and to Purple Heart recipients.

states.notes: Re-verified 2026-10-01 via official search results (vets.colorado.gov, dmva.colorado.gov, careers.colorado.gov, cdhs.colorado.gov, cpw.state.co.us); pages not fetched directly. vets.colorado.gov previously blocked automated access (HTTP 403).

states.name: Connecticut

programs.name: Property Tax Exemption for Veterans with Service-Connected Permanent and Total Disability
programs.blurb: Fully exempts the primary dwelling (or a motor vehicle if the veteran owns no home) from property tax for Connecticut veterans with a VA permanent and total service-connected disability rating, in addition to the longstanding wartime-service exemption.

programs.name: Veterans Tuition Waiver at Connecticut Public Colleges
programs.blurb: Waives 100% of tuition for General Fund courses at UConn, the Connecticut State Universities, and Connecticut community colleges for eligible wartime veterans, National Guard members, and certain dependents.

programs.name: Veterans' Preference for State Employment Examinations
programs.blurb: Adds ten points to passing open-competitive state examination scores for wartime veterans receiving VA compensation, and five points for other qualifying wartime veterans.

programs.name: Sgt. John L. Levitow Healthcare Center and Residential Facility (Rocky Hill)
programs.blurb: The state veterans campus in Rocky Hill runs a 125-bed Medicare- and Medicaid-certified skilled nursing facility for veterans needing long-term care, alongside a residential program offering temporary supportive housing aimed at a return to independent living.

programs.name: Free Fishing License for Veterans with Disabilities
programs.blurb: Provides a free recreational fishing license through CT DEEP to veterans with a service-related or other qualifying disability.

states.notes: Re-verified 2026-10-01 via official portal.ct.gov search results; pages not fetched directly. Residential program detail: https://portal.ct.gov/dva/knowledge-base/articles/residential-programs/residential-facility/residential-facility-programs-and-services

states.name: Delaware

programs.name: Disabled Veterans School Property Tax Credit
programs.blurb: Provides a credit against 100% of non-vocational school district property taxes on the primary residence for veterans rated 100% permanently and totally disabled (including individual unemployability) with three years of Delaware domicile.

programs.name: Educational Benefits for Children of Deceased Veterans and Others
programs.blurb: Provides tuition assistance at Delaware public institutions for children of service members who died in service or from service-connected causes, alongside tuition programs for Delaware National Guard members.

programs.name: Veterans' Preference in State Merit Employment
programs.blurb: Awards five additional points to veterans and ten to veterans with a disability in screening and ranking for initial appointment to Delaware state merit employment.

programs.name: Delaware Veterans Home
programs.blurb: State-operated long-term skilled nursing facility in Milford providing 24-hour clinical care, memory support, and therapeutic programming for Delaware veterans.

programs.name: Hunting, Trapping, and Fishing License Exemption for Veterans with Disabilities
programs.blurb: Allows honorably discharged veterans with a VA service-connected disability of at least 60% to hunt, trap, and fish in Delaware without charge via a DNREC license exemption.

states.notes: Delaware's veterans agency operates as the Office of Veterans Services under the Department of State, advised by the Delaware Commission of Veterans Affairs. Re-verified 2026-10-01 via official delaware.gov search results; pages not fetched directly. DNREC exemption application form: https://documents.dnrec.delaware.gov/fw/Licensing/Disabled-Veterans-Exempt-Application.pdf

states.name: District of Columbia

programs.name: Disabled Veterans Homestead Deduction
programs.blurb: Reduces the assessed value of the principal residence of a DC-domiciled veteran with a VA total-and-permanent (or 100% unemployability) rating, subject to a household income cap; surviving spouses may retain the benefit.

programs.name: Veterans Preference in DC Government Hiring
programs.blurb: Qualified veterans receive a five-point preference, and disabled veterans and certain eligible spouses and survivors a ten-point preference, in competitive hiring for District government positions administered by the DC Department of Human Resources.

programs.name: DOES Veteran Services and Priority of Service
programs.blurb: The DC Department of Employment Services gives veterans and eligible spouses priority of service at American Job Centers, including a 24-hour veterans-only hold on new job orders.

programs.name: Veterans Specialty License Plates
programs.blurb: Veterans can purchase branch-specific DC specialty tags whose fees fund the Office of Veterans Affairs Fund, and veterans with a VA service-connected permanent and total disability pay no annual registration fee for one set of tags on a non-commercial vehicle.

programs.name: Veteran Designation on DC Driver License
programs.blurb: Honorably discharged veterans can add a veteran designation to their DC driver license or ID card by presenting a DD 214, WD AGO, or DD 256 form to DC DMV.

states.notes: DC has no District-run state veterans home (the Armed Forces Retirement Home in DC is federal) and no District-level veteran tuition waiver program; education support runs through federal GI Bill benefits with claims assistance from MOVA. Homestead deduction applications are handled through MOVA/communityaffairs.dc.gov; properties receiving it cannot also take the standard Homestead, Senior/Disabled relief, or tax-cap credit (otr.cfo.dc.gov). Re-verified 2026-10-01 via official dc.gov search results; pages not fetched directly.

states.name: Florida

programs.name: Veteran Property Tax Exemptions
programs.blurb: Veterans with a wartime or service-connected disability of 10% or more receive a $5,000 reduction in assessed value on property they own, and honorably discharged veterans with a service-connected total and permanent disability are fully exempt from property taxes on their homestead.

programs.name: Congressman C.W. Bill Young Veteran Tuition Waiver Program
programs.blurb: Waives out-of-state tuition and fees at Florida public postsecondary institutions for honorably discharged veterans residing in Florida, extended to spouses and dependent children using GI Bill benefits.

programs.name: Veterans' Preference in Public Employment
programs.blurb: Honorably discharged veterans (and certain spouses and family members) who meet position requirements are guaranteed hiring preference at every step of the process for state and local government jobs in Florida.

programs.name: Florida State Veterans' Homes
programs.blurb: FDVA operates one of the nation's largest state veterans' home systems, with eight skilled nursing homes and an assisted living facility providing long-term care to eligible veterans and, under recent law, qualifying spouses.

programs.name: Persons with Disabilities Hunting/Fishing License for Disabled Veterans
programs.blurb: Florida-resident, honorably discharged veterans with a VA service-connected disability rating of 50% or more qualify for a free five-year license covering hunting, freshwater and saltwater fishing, and most permits, alongside the discounted Military Gold Sportsman's License for active duty and retired service members.

states.notes: Florida has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed. Military Gold Sportsman's License details: https://myfwc.com/license/recreational/military-gold/. Re-verified 2026-10-01 via official search results (floridavets.org, floridarevenue.com, myfwc.com); pages not fetched directly. The 'qualifying spouses' admission detail for state veterans' homes was not re-surfaced in this pass and is carried forward from the prior verification.
